name: GRIPM Advanced Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: GRIPM Advanced Materials Co., Ltd. engages in the design, research and development, production, and sales of non-ferrous metal powder materials in China and internationally. It offers copper-based metal powder materials, microelectronic interconnect materials, and 3D printing powder materials, as well as electrolytic copper, atomized copper, copper alloy, tin, infiltration copper, FeCu pre-alloy, fine pre-alloyed, fine copper and cobalt, and CuSn diffusion powders.
